Perfecta para almacén, centro de distribución, producción, exposición comercial o sede empresarial, ofrece unas instalaciones que destacan por su gran potencial y múltiples posibilidades de uso.

inv.desc_en:
OPPORTUNITY. MAGNIFICENT COMMERCIAL, INDUSTRIAL, OR LOGISTICS WAREHOUSE FOR RENT. PRICE NEGOTIABLE.

Start up or expand your business with this magnificent warehouse, ideal for commercial, industrial, or logistics activities. A spacious, versatile, and functional space, prepared to adapt to the needs of all types of companies.

Perfect for a warehouse, distribution center, production facility, commercial showroom, or corporate headquarters, it offers facilities that stand out for their great potential and multiple possibilities for use.

Price negotiable.

An excellent opportunity to boost your company. Request more information and arrange a visit.
